## About this site

This is a beginner-friendly collection of practice questions for the **Basics of Computer Science** course at Hochschule Bielefeld (HSBI). It focuses on programming fundamentals in C and helps you prepare for exams.

## Who I am

I am **Natnael Fesseha**, a Mechatronics and Automation student at Hochschule Bielefeld (HSBI), Campus Gütersloh.

I also work as a student assistant at HSBI, where I support the C and C++ programming courses and run tutorials for students.
